title: Connections, overload and capacity
brief: Distinguish connections, active work and queued requests, then budget admitted work and recovery headroom around the real limiting resource. Choose bounded overload behaviour and validate capacity under a representative workload.

neighbouring_ownership.application-sql: Owns the lifecycle of an individual connection.
neighbouring_ownership.cluster-change: Owns temporary capacity and redundancy consumed by movement.

title: Inside PostgreSQL
brief: Trace one connection and request through PostgreSQL processes, shared buffers, heap tuples and indexes. Explain tuple visibility, HOT updates and their physical limits so native plans and maintenance have a concrete physical setting.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-vacuum: Owns retained horizons and transaction-age maintenance.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-wal: Owns durability controls and crash drills.

title: PostgreSQL vacuum and transaction age
brief: Diagnose retained PostgreSQL versions, visibility and transaction-age risk before changing maintenance. Distinguish reusable space from bloat and file shrinkage; choose vacuum and related interventions from retained horizons and age evidence.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-architecture: Owns first visibility and HOT explanation.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-replication: Owns standby and slot retention policy.

title: PostgreSQL WAL, checkpoints and durability
brief: Interpret PostgreSQL WAL progress, checkpoint work and commit settings against a tested durability promise. Explain an isolated crash drill and its restart evidence without extrapolating to power loss or lost storage.

neighbouring_ownership.storage-durability: Owns general mechanism and failure distinctions.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-backup: Owns backup chains, targets and restore.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-replication: Owns standby progress and synchronous-copy promises.
